name: All In One Lightbox – show any media in beautiful popups
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Turn images, audio, video, and any custom content into responsive lightbox popups and galleries – directly in the WordPress block editor, no coding required.

Lightbox Block | Documentation | Pricing | Support | Live Demo

Why All In One Lightbox?

Cramming media into a page makes it cluttered – a lightbox lets content shine on demand. Lightbox Block is a Gutenberg plugin that displays different types of media inside a popup: create image galleries, audio playlists, video showcases, or show any custom content in a clean, interactive lightbox. It is simple to use and requires no coding knowledge.

The plugin is fully responsive, so your popups look good on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. Customize layouts, choose from different styles, and adjust settings to match your design – ideal for portfolios, tutorials, product galleries, media libraries, and any site where you want to highlight content.

Free Features

  • Five Lightbox Types: Gallery, Button, Audio, Video, and Content lightboxes for different kinds of media.
  • Gallery Content Support: Build galleries with images, audio, video, or custom content blocks.
  • Multiple Blocks Per Page: Add different lightbox types on the same page without conflicts.
  • Button Lightbox: Trigger popups with customizable buttons placed anywhere in your content.
  • Embed External Media: Supports YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted videos for quick playback.
  • Mobile Responsive: Popups automatically adapt to all screen sizes.
  • Slideshow & Fullscreen Modes: Present galleries as interactive slideshows or expand media fullscreen.
  • Captions Support: Add titles or descriptions to each popup for context.
  • Independent Galleries: Run multiple galleries on one site, each working separately.
  • Layout Options: Choose between the default grid or the Masonry layout.
  • Custom Layout Controls: Adjust row/column gaps and layout spacing for better design control.

Pro Version

The Lightbox Block Pro version adds more flexibility and advanced controls for media playback and customization.

Pro features include:

  • Shortcode Support: Insert lightboxes anywhere on your site, even outside Gutenberg.
  • Extended Media Types: Embed PDFs, iframes, YouTube videos, and custom HTML alongside images, audio, and video.
  • Custom Overlay & Captions: Change caption style and overlay colors to match your branding.
  • Autoplay Slideshows: Automatically start popup slideshows for smooth presentations.
  • Mouse-Wheel Navigation: Scroll to zoom or move between slides.
  • Advanced Slide Effects: Slide, CrossFade, Classic, or Default transitions.
  • Topbar Controls: Slide counts, zoom, rotate (clockwise/counter-clockwise), flip, and fullscreen toggle in the popup topbar.
  • Toolbar Actions: Sharing (Facebook, Twitter), downloads, slideshow controls, thumbnails, and close buttons inside the popup.
  • Thumbnail Previews: Classic or Modern gallery thumbnails for easy navigation.
  • Advanced Media Player Controls: Play/pause, restart, rewind, fast-forward, progress bar, duration, mute, volume, PiP, Airplay, settings, download, and fullscreen.
  • Multiple Audio Players: Four different audio player designs.
  • Hover Effects: Zoom, Rotate, or Shine animations for gallery items.
  • Gallery Styling: Border radius plus five aspect ratios (Landscape, Square, Horizontal, Vertical, Portrait).
  • Color & Size Controls: Modal background, close icon colors, and per-device modal/icon sizes.
  • Slider Layout: Use a slider format for galleries instead of grid or masonry.

Try the Pro Version – Unlock all premium features today!

How to Use Lightbox Block – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate Lightbox Block.
  2. In the Gutenberg editor, add a Lightbox Block from the Widgets section.
  3. Select your lightbox type (Gallery, Button, Audio, Video, Content).
  4. Upload media or embed from YouTube/Vimeo.
  5. Adjust layout, spacing, and display options from the block sidebar.
  6. Publish your post or page and enjoy your new interactive lightbox!

Live Demo | Try the Pro Version

Use Cases

  • Portfolios: Present design, photography, and creative work in clean popup galleries.
  • Product galleries: Let shoppers view product photos and videos in fullscreen detail.
  • Tutorials & courses: Open videos and supporting content in focused popups.
  • Media libraries: Organize audio playlists and video showcases without cluttering the page.

Did you like this plugin? Hate it? Want a new feature? Send us your feedback

  • 3D Viewer – Display interactive 3D models on the webs.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Lightbox Block”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. In the block editor, search for the Lightbox Block and add it to any page or post.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the Lightbox Block plugin (.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the lightbox-block.zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin – or upload the extracted folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate from the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
Is Lightbox Block free?

Yes, Lightbox Block is a free Gutenberg block plugin. A Pro version adds extended media types, shortcode support, and advanced controls.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any standard WordPress theme.

What types of content can I show in a lightbox?

The free version supports images, audio, video, and custom content in five lightbox types (Gallery, Button, Audio, Video, Content). The Pro version adds PDFs, iframes, and custom HTML.

Can I embed YouTube or Vimeo videos in the popup?

Yes. YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted videos are supported for quick video playback.

Can I use multiple lightboxes on the same page?

Yes. You can add different lightbox types within the same page without conflicts, and multiple galleries each work independently.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change all block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse the block?

You can use it unlimited times across your site.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the LightBox Block plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.
